author: Home Repair Tutor
description:
This video shares how to install the Panasonic Whisper Green Select Bathroom exhaust fan. For a written tutorial with pictures, visit https://homerepairtutor.com/bathroom-exhaust-fan-install/

Many thanks to Panasonic for sending this fan for my client's bathroom remodel

How to Install the Panasonic Whisper Green Select Bath Fan
0:01 Introduction
0:09 Cutting the exhaust fan hole
0:27 Installing the fan bracket
0:45 Wiring the fan
1:17 Adding fan ductwork
1:41 Panasonic fan adapter installation
1:57 Panasonic fan body installation
2:19 LED grill installation


These supplies were used in our video:

-Panasonic Whisper Green Select Model FV-0511VKSL3K
-Stud finder
-6-inch insulated ductwork 
-6-inch warm drive clamps
-Foil tape
-14/3 Romex wire
